verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Sabbaṁ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ tattha cittaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without directly knowing and completely understanding the all, without dispassion for it and giving it up, you can’t end suffering.

verses.pali: Sabbañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ tattha cittaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
verses.english: By directly knowing and completely understanding the all, having dispassion for it and giving it up, you can end suffering.”
That is what the Buddha said.
“Those who know the all as all,
and have risen above all suffering.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
